The Bucs reached back out to Baker Mayfield's camp late last week—knowing the sides weren't far off when talks broke off. Mayfield agreed to try again, and the team added a year to its offer.

Things were always amicable, even if Baker was ... pretty straight-forward publicly.

Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield's new deal is for a total of $205 million over four years. The cashflow: $50 million this year, $50 million next year, $50 million in 2028, $55 million in 2029.

The total injury guarantee (including $30M already paid this year) is $150 million.

Tampa’s now done deals for Tristan Wirfs, Zyon McCollum, Luke Goedeke, Vita Vea and Baker Mayfield over the last three summers—all between the start of camp and Week 1.

(That camp deadline was never real.)

The Buccaneers’ three-year, $165 million extension with QB Baker Mayfield gives the team his rights through the end of the decade. And $55 million per was always the sweet spot.

Mayfield moved his family to Tampa a couple years back as a sign he was all-in. Now he really is.

Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez's full guarantee at signing—$53.928 million—is second best ever at his position, behind only Seahawks CB Devon Witherspoon and well clear of Rams CB Trent McDuffie.

A few notes ...

• Gonzalez gets $33M raise over what was left on the last 2 years of his rookie deal—same as Witherspoon's raise.

• Gonzalez got early vesting dates on '28/'29, which McDuffie got, Witherspoon did not.

• That makes 4 years and $96.93M virtually guaranteed.

Details on Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez's four-year, $135 million extension ...

• $33 million signing bonus.

• $53.928 million first two years—fully guaranteed.

• 2028 money becomes fully guaranteed in March 2027.

• 2029 money becomes fully guaranteed in March 2028.
